issues.passage: Their consideration of the proposal lasted three seconds before automatic approval.
issues.why: Valid, natural use of consideration = thought about something; brief or cursory consideration is still correctly named consideration (cf. “after brief consideration”). A student who knows the word would accept this sentence.

fix.correctPassage: After lengthy consideration of the budget forecasts, the board postponed expansion.
wrongPassages: She showed consideration for the neighbors by blasting music until well after midnight.
She acted with consideration when she decided on the spot without reading a single page.
The engineer measured consideration in milliliters before sealing the sample vial.
